BACKPORT: media: staging/intel-ipu3: parameter buffer refactoring Current ImgU driver processes and releases the parameter buffer immediately after queued from user. This does not align with other image buffers which are grouped in sets and used for the same frame. If user queues multiple parameter buffers continuously, only the last one will take effect. To make consistent buffers usage, this patch changes the parameter buffer handling and group parameter buffer with other image buffers for each frame. Each time driver will queue one more group of buffers when previous frame processed and buffers consumed by css. Signed-off-by: Tianshu Qiu <tian.shu.qiu@intel.com> Signed-off-by: Bingbu Cao <bingbu.cao@intel.com> Signed-off-by: Sakari Ailus <sakari.ailus@linux.intel.com> Signed-off-by: Mauro Carvalho Chehab <mchehab+samsung@kernel.org> (cherry picked from commit 8ecc7c9da013e702aa889002e1288521d7533293 git://linuxtv.org/media_tree.git master) BUG=b:139647343 TEST=Sanity checked basic camera functions.
